tabs.label: iDrive overrides
tabs.unlockWarning: These settings override the options in iDrive's Android Auto Settings page. A line in nbt-aad.env always wins over the checkbox in iDrive.

settings.label: Video resolution
settings.description: The picture size the phone renders; decoder size, insets, DPI and touch all follow it. 800x480 is softer but runs 3D maps more smoothly; 1920x1080 is an experiment that crashed a 2 GB head unit.

settings.label: Video frame rate
settings.description: The frame rate asked of the phone and declared to the decoder. 30 can be smoother on a slower head unit; 60 asks the phone for 60 fps.

settings.label: Video frame queue
settings.description: Maximum number of video frames waiting to be decoded. Lower it to reduce memory use and backlog on slower head units.

settings.label: Video DPI
settings.description: Higher makes Android Auto's picture bigger but leaves less room; from about 150 up the rail can run out of height. 0 keeps the phone's own DPI.

settings.label: Hide rail status icons
settings.description: Asks the phone not to draw its clock, signal and/or battery at the top of the rail, so the rail icons get more height.

settings.label: Screen size
settings.description: The panel size as WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 1440x540 for BMW's 10.25" screen. Only needed when the size is detected wrongly.
settings.unset: From carplay.ini or the display, else 1280x480

settings.label: Car make shown
settings.description: The car make Android Auto shows, e.g. on its exit icon.

settings.label: Driver's side
settings.description: The side of the car the driver sits on, as told to Android Auto. Nothing reads it from the car.

settings.label: Force day or night
settings.description: Forces Android Auto's day or night colours instead of following the car's lights.

settings.label: Phone silence timeout
settings.description: Seconds without data from the phone before the session is treated as lost and iDrive gets the screen back. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: BACK hold to minimize
settings.description: How long BACK must be held to minimize Android Auto. 0 turns it off and sends BACK to the phone at once.

settings.label: After connecting go to
settings.description: Where iDrive goes once the phone connects.

values.label: Stay in the Android Auto menu

settings.label: Step aside on hard keys
settings.description: On restores the old behaviour where Android Auto steps aside when a hard key (MENU, MEDIA, NAV ...) is pressed. Off keeps Android Auto on screen.

settings.label: Camera screen contexts
settings.description: Comma-separated iDrive context numbers that are camera views: Android Auto steps aside while one is up. The app log names unknown candidates; the list replaces the default.

settings.label: Ignored iDrive screens
settings.description: Comma-separated iDrive context numbers that never make Android Auto step aside, for screens Android Auto already shows (messages, calls, now playing).

settings.label: Reverse knob direction
settings.description: Reverses the iDrive controller's rotary direction.

settings.label: Controller instance
settings.description: The CCS35up iDrive controller instance. Only change it if the controller does nothing in Android Auto.

settings.label: Older controller instance
settings.description: The instance of an older CCS iDrive controller.

settings.label: MENU key code
settings.description: The Android keycode the MENU hard key sends to the phone. 0 ignores the key, so it stays with iDrive.

settings.label: BACK key code
settings.description: The Android keycode the BACK hard key sends to the phone. 0 ignores the key, so it stays with iDrive.

settings.label: OPTION key code
settings.description: The Android keycode the OPTION hard key sends to the phone. 0 ignores the key, so it stays with iDrive.

settings.label: COM key code
settings.description: The Android keycode the COM hard key sends to the phone. 0 ignores the key, so it stays with iDrive.

settings.label: MEDIA key code
settings.description: The Android keycode the MEDIA hard key sends to the phone. 0 ignores the key, so it stays with iDrive.

settings.label: NAV key code
settings.description: The Android keycode the NAV hard key sends to the phone. 0 ignores the key, so it stays with iDrive.

settings.label: MAP key code
settings.description: The Android keycode the MAP hard key sends to the phone. 0 ignores the key, so it stays with iDrive.

settings.label: Media level under prompts
settings.description: Native audio: how far media is turned down while a system sound, or a nav prompt mixed into the music, plays.

settings.label: Log file
settings.description: Appends the daemon log to this file (e.g. on a USB stick), so it survives a head-unit reset. The same name is appended to.

settings.label: Wireless Android Auto
settings.description: The head unit hosts wireless Android Auto. Off falls back to the old mode that scans for a phone running "Start head unit server".

settings.label: Touch screen
settings.description: Sends touches on the car's screen to the phone.

settings.label: iDrive controller
settings.description: Sends the iDrive controller and hard keys to the phone.

settings.label: Car microphone
settings.description: Sends the car's microphone to the phone for calls and the Assistant.

settings.label: Microphone speech scenario
settings.description: Routes the car's microphone to the Assistant through the car's speech scenario. Without it the Assistant hears silence.

settings.label: Refocus Bluetooth after Assistant
settings.description: Asks for the car's Bluetooth source again after the Assistant closes the mic, so its reply is heard.

settings.label: Prompts in Bluetooth audio
settings.description: Bluetooth mode only: navigation prompts are mixed into the Bluetooth audio.

settings.label: Car GPS to phone
settings.description: Sends the car's GPS position to the phone. See also Use Phone GPS.

settings.label: Car speed to phone
settings.description: Sends the car's wheel speed to the phone.

settings.label: Car gear to phone
settings.description: Sends the car's gear to the phone. Stepping aside in reverse is Reverse gear handling.

settings.label: Parking brake to phone
settings.description: Sends the car's parking brake state to the phone.

settings.label: Reverse gear handling
settings.description: Android Auto steps aside for the reverse camera and comes back afterwards.

settings.label: Park assist handling
settings.description: Android Auto steps aside while park assist shows its parking view.

settings.label: Hide while no phone
settings.description: iDrive gets the screen while no phone is connected. Off keeps the Android Auto overlay up for the whole run.

settings.label: Repair picture after drops
settings.description: After a dropped video frame, asks the phone for a fresh keyframe. Off leaves the picture damaged until the phone's next keyframe.

settings.label: Volume overlay
settings.description: Shows a volume pill over Android Auto when the car's volume changes. Turn it off if it causes a black screen.

settings.label: Gesture control passthrough
settings.description: BMW Gesture Control keeps working over Android Auto. Turn it off if Android Auto touch stops working.

settings.label: Lane guidance in cluster
settings.description: Shows the phone's lane row in the cluster and HUD. Off keeps the arrows only.

settings.label: 6WA junction view
settings.description: 6WA cluster: near the turn the arrow gives way to a junction view. Off keeps the arrow all the way to the turn.

settings.label: Keep iDrive on Android Auto
settings.description: While Android Auto is on screen, iDrive is held on a blank state so the knob and touch go to Android Auto. Off restores the old behaviour.

settings.label: Step aside for car screens
settings.description: Screens the car opens by itself (camera button, Top/Side View, safety menus, Check Control) make Android Auto step aside until its entry is chosen again.

settings.label: Restart on Settings change
settings.description: Restarts nbt-aad when a checkbox on iDrive's Android Auto Settings page changed, so the change applies at once.

settings.label: Control port
settings.description: The single-instance control port (UDP 127.0.0.1:52790) used to stop and query a running daemon.

settings.label: Keep the packet filter
settings.description: Don't turn the packet filter off at start. Only with the Android Auto rules installed in pf.conf (pf_aa --install).

settings.label: Android Auto TCP port
settings.description: The TCP port the phone is told to connect to. 52770 failed on one car.

settings.label: Bluetooth handshake mode
settings.description: Pins the Bluetooth handshake mode instead of rotating through them on failures.

settings.label: Bluetooth re-registration interval
settings.description: While no Android Auto Bluetooth link is open, register the service again this often for 2 minutes, then every 30 s. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Re-registration hold
settings.description: Re-registration is held this long after the phone last asked for the link. 0 = no hold.

settings.label: Bluetooth link direction check
settings.description: Leaves Bluetooth links the car opened to the BMW Apps (MyBMW, AAIdrive) once Android Auto is known to use phone-opened links.

settings.label: Bluetooth link listen time
settings.description: Listens this long on each new Bluetooth serial link before writing, so a MyBMW link that speaks first is left alone. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Silent link strikes
settings.description: A Bluetooth node whose links end this many times in a row without an Android Auto reply is left to the BMW Apps for a while. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: WiFi Direct group name
settings.description: Pins the WiFi Direct group name offered to the phone instead of reading it from the car.

settings.label: WiFi Direct interface
settings.description: The network interface of the WiFi Direct group.

settings.label: Set own WiFi Direct password
settings.description: Whether nbt-aad sets the WiFi Direct passphrase itself. Auto does it only when the car has no usable WFDPass.conf.

settings.label: WiFi Direct password
settings.description: Pins the passphrase nbt-aad sets for the WiFi Direct group: 8 to 63 characters, no quotes, semicolons, backslashes or braces.

settings.label: WiFi Direct watch interval
settings.description: How often nbt-aad checks whether the car took its own WiFi Direct group back. 0 turns it off; values below 5 count as 5.

settings.label: USB: read through io-usb
settings.description: With Android Auto over USB, the phone is read directly through io-usb. Off reads it through /dev/oap*, which loses data when another reader is present.

settings.label: USB: block the factory driver
settings.description: With USB read through io-usb, keeps the factory accessory driver from starting. Off stops it after it has started instead.

settings.label: Picture surface
settings.description: The LayerManager surface for the Android Auto picture. 1280 shares the factory CarPlay surface as before v1.9.20.

settings.label: Video insets
settings.description: The phone UI insets as top,bottom,left,right in pixels, or off for the plain manifest. Normally calculated from the panel size.

settings.label: Native 1:1 picture
settings.description: Experimental: shows the picture 1:1 when the panel fits inside the video canvas, avoiding scaling blur.

settings.label: Touch offset X
settings.description: Horizontal touch offset in canvas pixels. A MINI round display needs about -20 at 720p.

settings.label: Touch offset Y
settings.description: Vertical touch offset in canvas pixels.

settings.label: MM-Renderer wait
settings.description: How long to wait for the MM-Renderer at start.

settings.label: Start MM-Renderer if missing
settings.description: Starts the MM-Renderer when none is running, e.g. on a car without CarPlay coded.

settings.label: MM-Renderer boot wait
settings.description: With CarPlay coded: how long after boot the head unit's own MM-Renderer is waited for before nbt-aad starts one.

settings.label: CarPlay hand-off
settings.description: Gives the decoder back to CarPlay between Android Auto sessions. Off keeps the decoder as created at start.

settings.label: CarPlay live retune
settings.description: Gives the decoder CarPlay's settings when CarPlay takes the screen during a live Android Auto session.

settings.label: Prompts on nav prompter
settings.description: Plays navigation prompts on a car audio endpoint with their own focus, so the radio is ducked. Off keeps prompts in the native audio mix.
settings.unset: On in native audio, off in Bluetooth

settings.label: Prompt focus source
settings.description: The audio source requested for each prompt. 0 = no focus request.

settings.label: Prompt focus sink
settings.description: The audio sink requested for each prompt (0x1 = speakers).

settings.label: Prompt focus hold
settings.description: The prompt focus is released this long after the queued audio has played.

settings.label: System sound channel
settings.description: Offers the phone a separate system sound channel.

settings.label: Prompt sample rate
settings.description: Native audio: the only sample rate offered for navigation prompts.

settings.label: Media gain
settings.description: Native audio: a fixed gain for media.

settings.label: Navigation prompts gain
settings.description: Native audio: a fixed gain for navigation prompts.

settings.label: System sounds gain
settings.description: Native audio: a fixed gain for system sounds.

settings.label: Duck ramp down
settings.description: Native audio ducking: duck ramp down time when a prompt or system sound plays over media.

settings.label: Duck hold
settings.description: Native audio ducking: duck hold time when a prompt or system sound plays over media.

settings.label: Duck ramp up
settings.description: Native audio ducking: duck ramp up time when a prompt or system sound plays over media.

settings.label: Native audio connection
settings.description: The car's connection id for native audio. 0 = don't route, just play.

settings.label: Release audio after silence
settings.description: Native audio: release the car's audio source after this long without sound once media has played. 0 keeps it until the session ends.

settings.label: Release audio after a prompt
settings.description: Native audio: release the source this long after a prompt or system sound when no media is playing. 0 uses the silence rule.

settings.label: Refocus native audio after Assistant
settings.description: Native audio: ask for the audio source again when the mic closes.

settings.label: Native audio device rate
settings.description: The sample rate asked of the car's audio device; the car's device takes 22050 to 44100.

settings.label: Force device rate
settings.description: Experiment: ask the audio device for this rate even if it reports less. If the car refuses, there is no audio that session.

settings.label: Audio fragment size
settings.description: Native audio fragment size in bytes, rounded down to a power of two.

settings.label: Audio fragment count
settings.description: Number of native audio fragments.

settings.label: Late audio wait
settings.description: Native audio: wait up to this long for a slightly late block instead of padding it with silence. 0 pads at once.

settings.label: Audio pre-roll
settings.description: Native audio: hold each stream at its start until this much audio is queued, against crackle in prompts. 0 plays at once.

settings.label: Clock drift correction
settings.description: Native audio: trims media playback slightly to follow the phone's clock, so a long drive doesn't crackle or drift.

settings.label: Drift correction loop
settings.description: Which loop sets the drift trim.

settings.label: Mixer thread priority
settings.description: Native audio mixer thread priority. 0 leaves it alone.

settings.label: Resampler
settings.description: How Android Auto's audio is converted to the device rate.

settings.label: Speex quality
settings.description: Quality of the Speex resampler.

settings.label: Deferred audio acks
settings.description: Native audio: acknowledge audio frames once played, so the phone is paced by the car's clock. Off acks them on arrival.

settings.label: Unacked audio frames
settings.description: With deferred acks: how many audio frames the phone may run ahead.

settings.label: Force ack after
settings.description: With deferred acks: a frame unacked this long is acked anyway. 0 = never.

settings.label: Arrival time in acks
settings.description: Audio acks carry the time their frame arrived, as Google's head unit sends it.

settings.label: Report audio underflows
settings.description: Native audio: tell the phone when a stream ran dry.

settings.label: Protocol minor version
settings.description: Experiment: the Android Auto protocol minor version asked for (Google's head unit asks for 7).

settings.label: Bluetooth source connection
settings.description: Connection id of the car's Bluetooth audio source. 0 uses the old source/sink focus request.

settings.label: Bluetooth audio source
settings.description: Audio source for the old Bluetooth focus request.

settings.label: Bluetooth audio sink
settings.description: Audio sink for the old Bluetooth focus request.

settings.label: Release Bluetooth source
settings.description: Releases the car's Bluetooth audio source when the phone leaves.

settings.label: Bluetooth routing delay
settings.description: Wait this long after a session starts before asking for the car's Bluetooth source. 0 = at once.

settings.label: Audio routing retries
settings.description: Retries while the car refuses the audio source.

settings.label: Audio routing retry pause
settings.description: First pause between retries; it grows by 2 s per retry up to 12 s.

settings.label: Bluetooth PLAY after routing
settings.description: Experiment: once the car grants the Bluetooth source, send it PLAY like picking Bluetooth audio in iDrive.

settings.label: Bluetooth PLAY delay
settings.description: With Bluetooth PLAY after routing: how long to wait before sending PLAY.

settings.label: Dropped AA channels
settings.description: Android Auto channel numbers left out of service discovery, comma-separated; none drops nothing.

settings.label: Speech scenario name
settings.description: The car speech scenario used for the microphone, e.g. Carplay_Siri_1mic_RefCh.

settings.label: Fixed GPS accuracy
settings.description: A fixed accuracy for every car GPS fix sent to the phone.

settings.label: Reverse gear value
settings.description: The car's gear value for R.

settings.label: Neutral gear value
settings.description: The car's gear value for N.

settings.label: Neutral after reverse
settings.description: Manual gearbox: seconds in neutral straight after reverse before Android Auto comes back over the park-assist view. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Tell phone about reverse
settings.description: Also tells the phone it lost the screen while in reverse.

settings.label: Tell phone about BACK hold
settings.description: Also tells the phone it lost the screen when BACK is held to minimize.

settings.label: Park assist active values
settings.description: Comma-separated park assist status values that count as active.

settings.label: Driving mode display time
settings.description: With Show driving mode changes ticked: how long iDrive's driving-mode display stays up before Android Auto returns.

settings.label: Driving mode delay
settings.description: Wait this long after a driving-mode change before stepping aside, so iDrive has drawn its display.

settings.label: Voice button starts Assistant
settings.description: A long press of the steering-wheel voice button starts the Google Assistant; a short press stays iDrive's own voice. Off only logs the long press.

settings.label: Media button next track
settings.description: Steering-wheel or head-unit buttons (MOST 15/02) that become Android's next track key: fkt or fkt:value in hex, several separated by commas; a set value replaces the defaults. Needs Native media controls.

settings.label: Media button previous track
settings.description: Steering-wheel or head-unit buttons (MOST 15/02) that become Android's previous track key: fkt or fkt:value in hex, several separated by commas; a set value replaces the defaults. Needs Native media controls.

settings.label: Media button play/pause
settings.description: Steering-wheel or head-unit buttons (MOST 15/02) that become Android's play/pause key: fkt or fkt:value in hex, several separated by commas; a set value replaces the defaults. Needs Native media controls.

settings.label: Two-finger gesture capture
settings.description: Native audio: listens (receive-only) to the gesture camera so the two-finger gesture can skip tracks. Off stops the capture.

settings.label: Gesture camera interface
settings.description: The network interface the gesture camera's messages are read from.

settings.label: Media browser service
settings.description: Experiment: advertises the Android Auto media browser service and logs what the phone sends there.

settings.label: Turn shown at (time)
settings.description: In the last few seconds mode: seconds before the turn it shows in the cluster.

settings.label: Turn shown again at
settings.description: In the last few seconds mode: seconds before the turn it is shown again; must be below the first. 0 = never again.

settings.label: Off-ramp shown at
settings.description: Off-ramps and forks also show this many metres before them.

settings.label: Off-ramp shown again at
settings.description: Off-ramps and forks are shown again this many metres before them.

settings.label: Cluster distance bar
settings.description: Keeps the cluster's red distance bar, which means nothing without an iDrive route.

settings.label: Yield to iDrive routes
settings.description: Watches for iDrive's own navigation routes and gives the cluster to them.

settings.label: Cluster update method
settings.description: How the next turn is sent on a route already shown.

settings.label: 6WA junction view distance
settings.description: 6WA: the junction view comes in this close to the turn, whatever the time.

settings.label: 6WA Mapbox turn glyphs
settings.description: 6WA HUD: draws the turn arrows and roundabouts with the Mapbox maneuver glyphs instead of the simple built-in shapes.

settings.label: 6WA lane layer
settings.description: 6WA: the phone's lanes in the cluster's lane layer. Experimental.

settings.label: RAM log
settings.description: With no USB log, the daemon and the iDrive app log to RAM (5 MB each, fresh per run).

settings.label: Strip LD_PRELOAD for helpers
settings.description: Helper processes the daemon starts don't load the graphics libraries. Off is only useful when debugging a helper.

settings.label: Navigation in cluster/HUD
settings.description: The next turn, its distance and the road name in the instrument cluster and the HUD.

settings.label: Show directions
settings.description: When the next turn shows in the cluster and HUD: at once, in the last few seconds, or within a set distance.

settings.label: Directions distance
settings.description: Show a turn only within this many miles (also used when the phone sends no seconds). 0 shows it at once.

settings.label: HUD profile
settings.description: Which instrument cluster and HUD the turn arrows and song title are drawn for. 6WB has no driver yet, so it is not offered here.
settings.unset: As chosen in iDrive (G Series/Supra if none)

settings.label: Song title in gauge cluster
settings.description: While no turn is shown, the song the phone plays shows in the cluster's navigation area (the 6WA's street line, or a J29 guidance panel without an arrow).

settings.label: Cyrillic street names in HUD
settings.description: 6WA HUD: Cyrillic street names are sent instead of blanked. Needs a cluster font that has the letters.

settings.label: Disable logging
settings.description: Silences every log so a run leaves nothing to read. For a performance test only.

settings.label: Prompts on car radio (BT, beta)
settings.description: Bluetooth audio only: navigation prompts play on the car's own prompter, so the radio ducks.

settings.label: Android Auto over USB
settings.description: Android Auto over the car's USB port (experimental). While it is on, wireless Android Auto is not offered.

settings.label: Use Phone GPS
settings.description: For cars without the navigation antenna: the phone uses its own GPS, compass and motion sensors.

settings.label: Wi-Fi network
settings.description: The Wi-Fi network the phone is offered. WiFi Direct is for cars without the CarPlay hotspot.

settings.label: Audio mode
settings.description: How Android Auto's sound reaches the car: native audio over the Android Auto connection, or Bluetooth.
settings.idriveOption: Use Native Audio instead of Bluetooth

settings.label: Bluetooth media audio
settings.description: Only read when Audio mode is not set. Off selects the experimental A2I pipeline, which is not audible yet.
settings.idriveOption: Use Native Audio instead of Bluetooth

settings.label: Native media controls
settings.description: Native audio: the steering wheel's and the head unit's previous / next buttons control Android Auto's media, and the J29 cluster's track list shows its title.

settings.label: Two-finger gesture skips track
settings.description: Native audio: the gesture camera's two-finger gesture becomes next track. Off sends nothing, for cars where two fingers is set to mute in iDrive (the iDrive box is the reverse of this).
settings.unset: As ticked in iDrive (next track unless ticked)

settings.label: Nav prompts on their own channel
settings.description: Native audio: navigation prompts play on the car's nav prompt channel at navigation volume, and the car mutes the music for each one. Off mixes them into the music with the music ducked (the iDrive box is the reverse of this).
settings.unset: As ticked in iDrive (own channel unless ticked)

settings.label: CarPlay compatibility
settings.description: For cars that use the factory CarPlay as well as Android Auto. Turns on the three CarPlay fixes below.

settings.label: Yield fully to CarPlay
settings.description: Android Auto yields completely when CarPlay takes the screen.

settings.label: CarPlay decoder context
settings.description: What happens to the factory CarPlay decoder context: destroyed, or detached and re-attached afterwards.

settings.label: CarPlay window placement
settings.description: Where CarPlay's window goes after a hand-over: in Android Auto's window group, or top-level.
